senses.gloss:
अट, अस्, आ, अम्, roaming, wandering; (आ), f. the
act or habit of roaming or wandering about, especially
as a religious mendicant.

अट्ट, ind. high, lofty, loud; (अस्), m. top-heavy (?),
exceeding; shaking; injuring; N. of a Yakṣa; (अस्,
अम्), m. n. addition to a building, apartment on the
roof, upper story; tower, buttress, back of a building;
(corruption of हट्ट), a market, a market-place;
(आ), f. overbearing conduct ?; (अम्), n. (corruption of
अन्न ?), boiled rice, food; (अस्, आ, अम्), dried, dry.
—अट्ट-पति-भागाख्य-गृह-कृत्य (˚ग-आख्˚),
अम्, n. business of the house called the market-
master's department (an office in Kashmir).
—अट्ट-
स्थली, f. (site of an अट्ट), a name.
—अट्ट-हसित,
अम्, n. loud laughter, a horse-laugh.
—अट्ट-हास,
अस्, m. idem; a name of Śiva.
—अट्ट-हासक, अस्,
m., N. of a shrub, Jasminum Multiflorum or Hirsutum.
—अट्ट-हासिन्, ई, m. epithet of Śiva.
—अट्ट-हास्य,
अम्, n. loud laughter; a horse-laugh.
—अट्टाट्ट-हास
(˚ट्ट-अट्ट्˚), अस्, m. very loud laughter.
अट्टा, f. overbearing conduct (?), excess (?).
आट आट, अस्, m., N. of a serpent.
अटक, अस्, ई, अम्, roaming.
अट्टक, अस्, m. an apartment on the roof.
अटन, अम्, n. act or habit of wandering about.
अट्टन, अम्, n. a weapon shaped like a discus.

अटनि, इस्, f. or अटनी, f. the notched extremity of
a bow.

अटनि, अटवि, अटाट्या, &c., see under
अट् above.
अटमान, अस्, आ, अम्, roaming about, vagabond.

अटवि, इस्, or अटवी, f. (place to roam in), a forest.
—अटवि-शिखर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people or
country.

आटवी, f., N. of a town in the Mahā-bhārata (2.
1175).
अटविक, better आटविक, अस्, m. a woodman, forester.

आटविक आटविक, अस्, m. (fr. अटवी), the
inhabitant of a forest; a woodman, a pioneer.
अटाटा, f. (habit of) roaming or wandering about.
अट्टट्ट, ind. very high, very loud.
अटाट्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, roaming excessively.
अटाट्या, f. (habit of) roaming.

अटाय, nom. A. अटायते, to enter upon a roaming
life, to become a religious mendicant.

अट्टाय (nom. fr. अट्टा), A. अट्टायते (meaning
doubtful), to be overbearing (?).

अटरुष अटरुष or अटरूष or अटरूषक,
अस्, m., N. of the shrub Justicia Adhatoda.

आटरूष आटरूष, अस्, m., N. of the tree
Justicia Adhenatoda. See अटरूष or अटरूषक.

अटल अ-टल, अस्, आ, अम्, not shaky, firm,
solid.

अट्टाल अट्टाल, अस्, or अट्टालक, अस्, m. an
apartment on the roof, an upper story; (इका), f.
a house of two or more stories, a lofty house, palace;
N. of a country.
—अट्टालिका-कार, अस्, m. a bricklayer,
mason.
—अट्टालिका-बन्ध, अस्, m. (in architecture)
a kind of base.

आटव्य आटव्य, अस्, m., N. of a teacher in
the Vāyu-Purāṇa.

आट्टस्थलक आट्टस्थलक (fr. अट्ट-स्थली)
Gaṇa to Pāṇini IV. 2, 127.
